candidates.summary: More than 2,500 U.S. flights scheduled for November 14 were canceled, according to FlightAware figures reported by AP, as airlines recovered from Friday’s nationwide FAA ground stop. At a Saturday morning news conference, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said a contractor’s work replacing copper wiring with fiber had caused a system overload. He said investigators were examining whether faulty wiring or contractor performance was responsible. The cancellations were continuing disruption, not a new nationwide flight suspension.
candidates.title: Duffy links FAA disruption to wiring upgrade as Saturday cancellations continue

candidates.summary: An Israeli drone strike killed two Palestinians in Jabaliya on November 14, according to Shifa Hospital director Mohamed Abu Selmiya. The American field hospital reported additional wounded people without specifying a number. The Israeli military said it had struck two Hamas militants in the area.
candidates.title: Hospital officials report two Palestinians killed in Israeli strike in Jabaliya

candidates.summary: The Associated Press called the defeat of Alaska’s election-system repeal measure overnight on November 14, NPR reported. The measure would have repealed the state’s nonpartisan top-four primaries and ranked-choice general elections. The call concerns ballots cast in the November 3 election; it is not election certification.
candidates.title: AP calls defeat of Alaska measure to repeal ranked-choice voting
